caption: The drawing features an armchair with a dark green or black frame that is decorated with intricate, multicolored painted motifs. The top rail of the chair back displays an oval medallion in the center, depicting a scenic landscape with trees and a house in natural tones of green, brown, and cream; rectangular decorative panels flank either side. Vertical stiles and rails of the back and arms are adorned with floral or nature-inspired patterns in gold, red, green, and other colors. The chair’s seat is rectangular with slightly rounded front corners and is upholstered in a pale fabric featuring a repeating circular or medallion pattern. All four legs are slender and taper downward, each decorated with similar ornamental motifs as the rest of the frame. Above and to the right of the chair, there is a separate illustration of a decorative strip, showing more detail of the painted patterns used on the furniture, including floral and scenic elements. The background is plain with a light beige or off-white color, and there is a shadow-like stain beneath the chair, giving it some depth.
title: Chair
